notes.title: The Open Playtest for Holo & Veil is On!
notes.notes:
Hello!

The [b]Open Playtest[/b] for [b]Holo & Veil[/b] will start on Friday, [b]11/10/2023 at 12:00 AM (EST)[/b]!

This playtest will showcase an early "Beta" version of the game. [b]Anyone can sign up[/b] and there's no waitlist, so you'll gain access immediately once the playtest goes live.

I'm also excited to hear what you think! Please feel free to share your feedback through the [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2247830/discussions/]Steam Community[/url][/b]. If you prefer to comment on social media, no problem, you can do so from any of the links below.

See you then!
